name: Is it important to replace a failed window seal promptly?

mainEntity.name: Is it important to replace a failed window seal promptly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing a failed window seal promptly is important for several reasons. Beyond the aesthetic issue of a foggy window, a compromised seal means your window is no longer insulating effectively, leading to increased energy loss and higher utility bills. Prolonged moisture exposure within the panes can also promote mold growth, though typically contained, and can eventually degrade the window sash or frame.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prompt replacement prevents energy loss, higher bills, and potential long-term damage to the window frame.
